mapper.select: SELECT id, rate_code, level_code, department_id, department_name, billing_unit, cost_amount, currency, effective_date, expiry_date, status, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM ydsz_rate_internal WHERE rate_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, rate_code, level_code, department_id, department_name, billing_unit, cost_amount, currency, effective_date, expiry_date, status, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM ydsz_rate_internal WHERE level_code = #{levelCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND effective_date <= #{date} AND (expiry_date IS NULL OR expiry_date >= #{date}) AND deleted = 0 AND ( (department_id = #{departmentId} OR department_id IS NULL) ) ORDER BY (CASE WHEN department_id IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) LIMIT 1

SELECT id, rate_code, level_code, department_id, department_name, billing_unit, cost_amount, currency, effective_date, expiry_date, status, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM ydsz_rate_internal WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY level_code ASC
